integrity: Exact Markov-lumping and convexity proof, regenerative limit proof and independent vertex-state exact-rational checks. Historical priority has residual risks; self-review is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Regular finite core, marked pendant target, apex source and reset, fixed Bernoulli reset cost of one step. The distributional scaling requires diverging core size and degree and finite pendant-to-core ratio. No result for irregular cores, other targets or arbitrary reset protocols.
title: A sharp restart boundary for a regular trap with competing pendant targets
